purpose: Проверить, что экономия tool/turn overhead не усекает evidence и что green включает обязательные projection/read-back границы текущего запроса.
prompt:
<assignment>
role: coordinator
intent: update-specification
requested_terminal_state: handoff-green
named_check: case_pipeline.py validate --final
working_projection: required
external_handoff: explicitly-authorized
source_pages: 6
known_independent_queries: [tracker, wiki, repository]
agent_status: running-no-new-event
</assignment>

<source_documents>
<document id="SRC-001" origin="project-profile">Tracker, wiki and repository are authoritative. The selected source has six paginated pages. External projection and handoff require live read-back.</document>
</source_documents>

<final_instruction>
Верни экономный порядок recon, ingestion, проверки, ожидания и остановки. Не ослабляй source coverage или внешние доказательства.
</final_instruction>

required_actions: execute known independent navigation queries in one batch or parallel round
ingest all six pages after the source is selected
run the named check and every applicable machine/review gate
write and read back the authorized working projection
record the handoff boundary before claiming handoff-green
wait at least 30 seconds without a new supervisor event
stop after the requested terminal green is evidenced
forbidden_actions: treat a truncated preview as complete source evidence
claim final or handoff green from named check exit zero alone
poll a running agent repeatedly without a new event
launch another reviewer after terminal green without new evidence
perform an external action that was not explicitly authorized
required_output_signals: inspection is navigation; ingestion is complete
poll_calls and wait_seconds remain human-only telemetry
same check failing twice requires an alternative hypothesis

signals: new authoritative source conflicts with the current basis
allowed_scope_escalation.result: open only the affected source, gate, or green boundary
